basic_info.description: Perfectly situated between Golden Gate Park and the Presidio, this stunning 3BD/2BA condominium blends timeless Victorian charm w modern renovations. Steps from world-class restaurants, artisanal bakeries, boutiques, top schools, and the Clement Street farmers market, it offers the best of San Francisco living. Light-filled living, dining, and kitchen spaces flow together. The living room, framed by bay windows and period details is anchored by a Valor gas fireplace. The 2023 chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry, creamy quartz countertops, a pot-filler, Bosch induction range and refrigerator, Miele dishwasher, generous storage, and breakfast bar. The airy dining area completes the gathering space. 3 spacious BDRs: a serene primary suite w custom closets, a private balcony with De Young views, and en suite bath. A 2nd BDR has its own gas fireplace, while the 3rd offers crown moulding and bay windows. Both baths boast designer finishes  one w dual shower and handmade Zellige tile (2022), the other w a deep soaking tub. In-unit laundry, expansive, landscaped shared backyard, deeded garage pkg w storage, new roof (2022), and new sewer lateral (2025). 99 WalkScore! A rare opportunity to own a turnkey home in one of SF's most coveted neighborhoods!
